description: go2rtc is a free, open-source, ultimate camera streaming application with support for RTSP, RTMP, HTTP-FLV, WebRTC, HomeKit, FFmpeg, and more. It is the streaming engine bundled inside Frigate and is commonly used to restream RTSP camera feeds with low-latency WebRTC playback in the browser.
name: go2rtc
note: Web UI/API on port 1984. Edit /config/go2rtc.yaml to add your camera's RTSP source (e.g. rtsp://IP-CAM/ch0_0.h264). For full WebRTC/HomeKit functionality you may need to switch this container to host networking.
title: go2rtc
